turns.text: Personally, I don't think that they will use a have to make notes in the future because AI will take that over completely.
turns.zh: 我个人觉得，他们以后不会再用必须做笔记的方式了，因为 AI 会完全接管这件事。

turns.text: So, my opinion is you know, that that we should use more of it for that purpose.
turns.zh: 所以，我的观点是，你知道吧，我们应该在这方面多利用它。
咱们来说说你的分数吧。

turns.text: You will get 25% for fluency and coherence.
That means did you speak at an appropriate speed without unnatural pausing and did you answer the question?
turns.zh: 也就是说，你说话的速度是否合适、有没有不自然的停顿，以及你有没有回答问题？
发音，就是我能听懂你吗？
